questions.question: Which command scaffolds a new React + TypeScript project with Vite?
questions.explanation: npm create vite@latest runs Vite's scaffolding script; --template react-ts selects React with TypeScript. Create React App is deprecated.

questions.question: What does createRoot(...).render(...) in src/main.tsx do?
options: Connects React to a real DOM element and tells it what to display inside
questions.explanation: createRoot attaches React to one DOM node (the #root div) and render specifies the component tree to show there.

questions.question: In development, a console.log inside a component prints twice. What is the most likely reason?
options: StrictMode intentionally double-renders in development to surface bugs
The component has a bug that must be fixed
React always renders twice in production too
questions.explanation: StrictMode double-invokes rendering and effects in development only. Production builds render once.

questions.question: What does npm run build produce in a Vite project?
options: A running dev server with Hot Module Replacement
A Node.js server that renders React
An optimised static bundle of HTML, JS and CSS in dist/
questions.explanation: The build script outputs static production assets to dist/, which any static host can serve; npm run preview serves them locally.
